protocol.capture_pairing: Capture state_dump and asset_dump as close together as possible without changing game state.

experiments.name: Exploration baseline
sequence: Barry stationary in a known corridor
Walk within the same room and capture
Return to the same tile/camera position and capture
experiments.question: Which signals vary during movement while room geometry remains stable?

experiments.name: Inventory and item detail
experiments.question: Does WRAM bank 2 consistently identify the UI family and what distinguishes inventory from item detail?

experiments.name: PDA and menu screens
sequence: Open title/save menu separately if reachable
experiments.question: Can PDA pages be distinguished from other UI states?

experiments.name: Dialogue
experiments.question: Is dialogue geometry stable, and can text/speaker identity be proven from independent evidence?

experiments.name: Normal combat
sequence: Capture battle entry, several battle turns and exit
experiments.question: Which verified registers/state transitions distinguish combat from exploration and UI?

experiments.name: Boss combat
sequence: Capture multiple turns and boss phases
experiments.question: Can boss encounters be separated from normal combat using repeatable evidence?

experiments.name: Room transition
sequence: Capture first stable frame in destination
experiments.question: Which signals change at the transition boundary versus ordinary camera scrolling?

experiments.name: Cutscene
experiments.question: Can cutscene be distinguished from exploration, especially intro paths using WRAM bank 1?

experiments.name: Save and load
experiments.question: Which state changes identify save/load without conflating them with generic UI?

experiments.name: Character identity controls
sequence: Repeat equivalent state as Leon if available
Repeat equivalent state as Lucia if available
Capture dialogue with known speaker separately
experiments.question: Which independent signals identify active character versus dialogue speaker? HP addresses alone are not accepted as proof.

experiments.name: Look-alike room negative controls
sequence: Capture at least two visually similar but distinct rooms
Capture same room at different camera offsets
Capture revisit after leaving and returning
experiments.question: Can room fingerprinting reject false matches caused by repeated wall/corridor tiles?
